boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain University of Maryland-College Park
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food stops with published late availability in and around College Park.

cards.title: College Park Diner
cards.subtitle: 9206 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Use the diner when you need a sit-down meal late in the evening; its official site lists daily service from 6 a.m. to 2 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A diner with daily service extending to 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: College Park Diner publishes hours of 6 a.m.–2 a.m. every day at its Baltimore Avenue location.
cards.source_title: College Park Diner — Homepage
cards.access_notes: Official site lists the restaurant open every day, 6 a.m.–2 a.m.; confirm before traveling because schedules can change.

cards.title: Dog Haus Biergarten College Park
cards.subtitle: 7401 Baltimore Ave, Suite 1A, College Park
cards.notes: Plan a food-focused stop on Baltimore Avenue; the City’s business listing shows 1 a.m. closing on select days and 2 a.m. on Wed–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Baltimore Avenue food counter with published late closing times.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of College Park lists Dog Haus Biergarten hours through 2 a.m. Wednesday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: City of College Park — ITGA 2024 participating businesses
cards.access_notes: City listing gives 10 a.m.–2 a.m. Wed–Sat and 10 a.m.–1 a.m. Sun–Tue; verify on the day of your visit.

cards.title: Raising Cane's Baltimore Ave
cards.subtitle: 7400 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Choose pickup, dine-in, or drive-thru at this College Park location when the evening runs long; published closing reaches 2 a.m. Thu–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Chicken-finger restaurant open as late as 2 a.m. on select nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Raising Cane’s lists its 7400 Baltimore Ave location open until 2 a.m. Thursday through Saturday.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's — Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists 1 a.m. Sun–Wed and 2 a.m. Thu–Sat; dine-in and drive-thru availability may differ.

cards.title: Shake Shack College Park
cards.subtitle: 4394 Knox Rd, College Park
cards.notes: Head to Knox Road for burgers, chicken, hot dogs, or frozen custard; the location page posts midnight closes most weekdays and 1 a.m. weekends.
cards.short_summary: Knox Road counter service with midnight-or-later hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Shake Shack’s College Park page lists closing at midnight Monday–Thursday and 1 a.m. Friday, Saturday, and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Shake Shack — College Park, MD
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists midnight closes Mon–Thu and 1 a.m. Fri–Sun. Check the page for holiday or event changes.

cards.title: Taco Bell Baltimore Avenue
cards.subtitle: 8428 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Use the drive-thru for a late food run on Baltimore Avenue; published drive-thru hours extend beyond the dining room’s stated closing time.
cards.short_summary: A drive-thru option with service as late as 3 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 3 a.m. Thursday–Sunday at 8428 Baltimore Ave.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell — 8428 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru until 2–3 a.m.; its dine-in hours end earlier, so use the drive-thru schedule for late visits.

cards.title: Marathon Deli
cards.subtitle: 7412 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s ordering page for a pickup window after midnight; it posts online ordering from 12 a.m. through 2:40 a.m.
cards.short_summary: A Baltimore Avenue deli with a published after-midnight ordering window.
cards.evidence_claim: Marathon Deli’s ordering page lists online ordering hours of 12 a.m.–2:40 a.m. and 10 a.m.–10:40 p.m.
cards.source_title: Marathon Deli — Pickup and delivery
cards.access_notes: The official ordering page shows a midnight–2:40 a.m. online-ordering window; check pickup availability and timing before leaving.

cards.title: MidnighTreats College Park
cards.subtitle: 4513 College Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Order a plant-based cookie or oat-milk treat near campus; the company’s ordering page lists pickup through 11:45 p.m. most nights and 12:45 a.m. Fri–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Plant-based cookie shop with a late Friday and Saturday pickup window.
cards.evidence_claim: MidnighTreats’ College Park ordering page lists hours until 11:45 p.m. Sunday–Thursday and 12:45 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: MidnighTreats College Park — Online ordering
cards.access_notes: Official online ordering lists pickup through 11:45 p.m. Sun–Thu and 12:45 a.m. Fri–Sat; ordering cutoffs can vary.

cards.title: The Board and Brew
cards.subtitle: 8150 Baltimore Ave, College Park
cards.notes: Bring a group for food and a board-game session near campus; the business page lists service until 11 p.m. most nights and midnight on Fri–Sat.
cards.short_summary: Board-game café with Friday and Saturday hours reaching midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Board and Brew lists College Park hours until 11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and midnight Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: The Board and Brew — College Park
cards.access_notes: Official business page lists 11 p.m. Mon–Thu and midnight Fri–Sat; food, game, and seating availability should be checked directly.

cards.title: Maman Joon College Park
cards.subtitle: 4200 Hartwick Rd, Suite D-1, College Park
cards.notes: Use this Hartwick Road Persian-food counter for an evening meal; its College Park location page posts 11 p.m. closing every day.
cards.short_summary: Persian-food destination with daily 11 p.m. business hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Maman Joon’s College Park location page lists business hours of 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Saturday and noon–11 p.m. Sunday.
cards.source_title: Maman Joon Kitchen — College Park location
cards.access_notes: Official location listing posts daily closing at 11 p.m.; confirm availability before visiting, especially during university breaks.

cards.title: Yahentamitsi Dining Hall
cards.subtitle: University of Maryland campus, College Park
cards.notes: For a campus-based evening meal, use your eligible dining access before closing; Maryland Dining identifies Yahentamitsi as one of its three dining halls.
cards.short_summary: Campus dining hall whose official dining information describes evening service.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD Dining states that its dining halls are open from breakfast until 9 or 10 p.m. and identifies Yahentamitsi as one of the three dining halls.
cards.source_title: UMD Dining Services — Faculty & Staff Dining Plans
cards.access_notes: UMD Dining says dining halls operate until 9 or 10 p.m.; consult its current hours page or app for Yahentamitsi’s daily closing time.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named College Park campus places for studying, making, reflecting, gathering, and taking in student-facing culture.

cards.title: Set up a focused study block at McKeldin
cards.subtitle: Main campus library
cards.notes: Use the Find a Space tool before arriving, then choose a carrel or bookable room that fits solo work, a meeting, or a quieter reset.
cards.short_summary: A main-library stop with individual carrels and multiple study-space formats.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies McKeldin as its main campus library and lists individual study carrels on the third, fourth, and sixth floors, plus a Find a Space tool for individual and group study.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces & Tools | Student Success Office
cards.access_notes: Study-room availability and access rules vary; check UMD Libraries' Find a Space tool before going.

cards.title: Meet outdoors on the lawn by McKeldin
cards.subtitle: Outdoor mall in front of McKeldin Library
cards.notes: Bring a book, blanket, or low-key game for good weather, and leave room for scheduled programs and the main pedestrian path.
cards.short_summary: A central lawn that supports casual outdoor time and scheduled campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD's Terp Traditions page describes McKeldin Mall in front of McKeldin Library as a place for Frisbee, naps, and studying in good weather; Stamp manages it as an outdoor event venue.
cards.source_title: Terp Traditions | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: The mall is also a reservable event space; do not obstruct scheduled activities or pedestrian routes.

cards.title: Use Stamp as an between-classes anchor
cards.subtitle: Campus Drive student union
cards.notes: Check the building's current events or food options, then use the union as a practical meeting point for a group, a meal, or student involvement.
cards.short_summary: A campus-life hub with dining, student organizations, programs, and meeting space.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD Student Affairs describes Stamp as a hub for connection where students can study, eat with friends, find student groups, and experience traditions and cultural showcases.
cards.source_title: Stamp Student Union | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Building services and operating hours vary; consult Stamp's current hours before planning an indoor meetup.

cards.title: Make a group plan at TerpZone
cards.subtitle: Recreation center inside Stamp
cards.notes: Coordinate a bowling, billiards, or video-game session with friends, and check current availability or any reservation details before you head downstairs.
cards.short_summary: A Stamp recreation venue centered on bowling, billiards, games, and leagues.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp says TerpZone offers recreation activities including bowling, billiards, and video games, and its site invites visitors to bowl, play games, and join a league.
cards.source_title: Explore Our Spaces | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Confirm current operating hours, lane availability, and any activity charges with TerpZone before visiting.

cards.title: Add a gallery pause to a Stamp visit
cards.subtitle: Contemporary-art gallery inside Stamp
cards.notes: Look up the current exhibition first, then give yourself time to view the work and attend any gallery programming listed for that show.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery devoted to contemporary art by emerging and mid-career artists.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp describes the Stamp Gallery as dedicated to exhibiting contemporary art, with an emphasis on work by emerging and mid-career artists.
cards.source_title: Explore Our Spaces | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Check the gallery's current exhibition and building hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Jim Henson Statue and Memorial Garden
cards.title: Photograph Jim Henson and Kermit on the bench
cards.subtitle: Memorial garden outside Stamp
cards.notes: Walk through the garden and take a respectful photo with the bronze bench sculpture; it is an easy landmark to pair with a Stamp visit.
cards.short_summary: A memorial garden featuring a bronze sculpture of Maryland alumnus Jim Henson and Kermit.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD's Arboretum says the garden features a bronze statue of Kermit the Frog on a red-granite bench with creator and Maryland alumnus Jim Henson, and calls it a popular campus photo opportunity.
cards.source_title: Jim Henson Statue and Memorial Garden | Arboretum Outreach Center
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial garden; be considerate of other visitors and the landscaping while taking photos.

cards.title: Take a quiet lap through the Chapel garden
cards.subtitle: South side of Memorial Chapel
cards.notes: Walk the labyrinth or use a bench for a short pause, then leave the journals, memorial features, and reflective setting ready for the next visitor.
cards.short_summary: A contemplative Memorial Chapel garden with a labyrinth, benches, water features, and community journals.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp says the Garden of Reflection and Remembrance includes a labyrinth for walking, benches, water features, and journals for community expression.
cards.source_title: Gardens | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: This is a contemplative garden beside Memorial Chapel; keep noise low and respect memorial areas.

cards.title: Find the program on Hornbake Plaza
cards.subtitle: Outdoor plaza by Hornbake Library
cards.notes: Use the plaza as a recognizable outdoor rendezvous, especially when a registered student organization has scheduled a table, gathering, or expressive activity.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor venue used for campus organization events and gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp lists Hornbake Plaza among its managed outdoor venues, and its student-organization guidance identifies it as a reservable outdoor event space.
cards.source_title: RSO Event Guidelines | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Events and tabling may require advance reservation through Stamp; respect any setup and access controls in place.

cards.title: Catch a scheduled gathering at Nyumburu
cards.subtitle: Outdoor amphitheater near Nyumburu Cultural Center
cards.notes: Check the campus calendar or student-organization announcements for a program, then arrive early enough to find seating without interrupting setup or performers.
cards.short_summary: A named outdoor amphitheater managed for campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Stamp's event guidance identifies Nyumburu Amphitheater as an outdoor reservable event space and names it among outdoor venues that support student organizations' events and connection.
cards.source_title: RSO Event Guidelines | Adele H. Stamp Student Union
cards.access_notes: Programming is event-dependent; reservations are required for organized use of outdoor event spaces.

cards.entity_name: The Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.title: Put a Clarice performance on the calendar
cards.subtitle: Performing arts center on campus
cards.notes: Browse the season calendar for a concert, play, dance event, or community program, then confirm ticketing and arrival details on the individual event page.
cards.short_summary: The campus home for music, theatre, dance, performance studies, and the performing-arts library.
cards.evidence_claim: The Clarice says it is home to UMD's School of Music, Theatre, Dance, and Performance Studies, Clarice Presents, and the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library, with performances and community programming.
cards.source_title: The Clarice | The Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.access_notes: Event schedules, ticket requirements, and accessibility details depend on the individual performance.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten no-extra-purchase ways for currently enrolled Terps to spend time together on campus, plus one publicly welcoming garden stop.

cards.title: Run a court at Eppley
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center
cards.notes: Bring a currently enrolled friend, swipe your university ID, and use the basketball courts during facility access hours.
cards.short_summary: A no-extra-charge indoor court hang for students with RecWell access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says RecWell access is included in the student fee and identifies basketball among Eppley Recreation Center activities.
cards.source_title: Eppley Recreation Center | University Recreation & Wellness
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; RecWell access is included in the student fee and a university ID is used for entry.

cards.entity_name: Indoor Track at Eppley Recreation Center
cards.title: Walk laps indoors
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center
cards.notes: Meet at Eppley for a low-key walking lap session; check the facility page for current access and closure updates.
cards.short_summary: An indoor movement break that needs no separate purchase for enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog says access to RecWell facilities is included in the student fee and lists an indoor track at Eppley.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; bring a university ID. Facility access is included in the student fee.

cards.entity_name: Bouldering Zone at Eppley Recreation Center
cards.title: Try the bouldering zone
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center
cards.notes: Plan a short bouldering session together and follow RecWell staff guidance and posted facility safety rules.
cards.short_summary: A structured active hang inside Eppley for students already covered by RecWell.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies a bouldering zone among Eppley’s activities and says RecWell access is included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: Eppley Recreation Center | University Recreation & Wellness
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students with university ID access; follow posted RecWell requirements.

cards.title: Meet for a swim
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center Natatorium
cards.notes: Use the indoor pool for lap swimming or a relaxed aquatic break; confirm natatorium hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A pool meet-up included with student RecWell access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog says RecWell access is included in the student fee and that Eppley has indoor and outdoor pools for lap swimming and diving.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; university ID required. Check the Eppley page for current pool hours.

cards.title: Train at Ritchie
cards.subtitle: Ritchie Coliseum
cards.notes: Choose a cardio, weight-room, or functional-training session and meet afterward to cool down and compare routines.
cards.short_summary: A campus gym session with no separate entry purchase for enrolled students.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says RecWell facility access is included in the student fee and locates weight rooms, cardio centers, and functional training at Ritchie Coliseum.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students with a university ID; facility availability can vary.

cards.title: Move at Reckord Armory
cards.subtitle: Reckord Armory Gym
cards.notes: Make it a quick workout meet-up, then use the walk back across campus as time to catch up.
cards.short_summary: A named RecWell gym option covered through student access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists Reckord Armory Gym among facilities whose access is included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students; present a university ID to enter RecWell facilities.

cards.entity_name: Fitness Session at Regents Drive Garage Studios
cards.title: Use the Regents Drive studios
cards.subtitle: Fitness studios in Regents Drive Garage
cards.notes: Coordinate a simple gym session in the Regents Drive Garage studios and verify the space is open before meeting.
cards.short_summary: A named campus fitness-space hang included with RecWell student access.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists the fitness studios in Regents Drive Garage among RecWell facilities included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: For currently enrolled students with university ID access; check RecWell for current availability.

cards.entity_name: Outdoor Recreation at La Plata Beach
cards.title: Bring a game to La Plata Beach
cards.subtitle: La Plata Beach
cards.notes: Pack a frisbee, cards, or another item you already own and use this named outdoor RecWell area for a casual meet-up.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor campus activity area managed through RecWell.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies La Plata Beach as an outdoor recreation space it manages and says access to RecWell facilities is included in the student fee.
cards.source_title: University Recreation & Wellness | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: For current students using RecWell outdoor space; bring only your own equipment and follow posted field rules.

cards.entity_name: Bike Repair at the RecWell Bike Shop
cards.title: Tune up a bike together
cards.subtitle: RecWell Bike Shop, Cole Student Activities Building
cards.notes: Bring your bike to the shop for help with basic maintenance, or learn a repair step alongside a friend.
cards.short_summary: A practical campus hang with free repair and maintenance support for students.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog says the RecWell Bike Shop in the Cole Student Activities Building offers free repairs and maintenance and teaches students bike repair.
cards.source_title: University Recreation and Wellness | University of Maryland Catalog
cards.access_notes: Student-focused service; contact or visit RecWell for current shop procedures before bringing a bike.

cards.title: Pause in Moxley Gardens
cards.subtitle: Between the Riggs Alumni Center and the football stadium
cards.notes: Choose a bench for conversation, reading, or a quiet reset; enter only while the garden gates are open.
cards.short_summary: A publicly welcoming garden setting for an unhurried outdoor catch-up.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says students and visitors are welcome to enjoy Moxley Gardens any time the gates are open, including for studying, chatting, or relaxing.
cards.source_title: Dessie M. Moxley Gardens | Arboretum Outreach Center
cards.access_notes: Students and visitors are welcome when gates are open; no admission or purchase is stated for garden enjoyment.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented UMD rituals, landmarks, and shared campus practices—from Testudo luck to a student-section newspaper stunt.

cards.title: Rub Testudo’s Nose
cards.subtitle: Good-luck ritual at the bronze Testudo by McKeldin Library
cards.notes: Find the bronze Testudo outside McKeldin Library and notice the polished nose. Students rub it for good luck, especially when an exam is looming.
cards.short_summary: A well-worn campus luck ritual centered on UMD’s bronze terrapin mascot.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies rubbing the nose of the bronze Testudo outside McKeldin as its quintessential and most well-known good-luck tradition.
cards.source_title: Traditions & History | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark in front of McKeldin Library; use normal campus access practices.

cards.title: Leave a Finals Offering for Testudo
cards.subtitle: Finals-time ritual at the McKeldin Library Testudo
cards.notes: During finals, look for the offerings left by students at Testudo. Keep the visit respectful and follow any posted campus guidance for the area.
cards.short_summary: Students add small offerings to Testudo during finals in hopes of a good grade.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that students began leaving Testudo offerings during finals in the early 1990s, hoping for a good grade.
cards.source_title: Landmarks | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: View the outdoor statue near McKeldin Library; do not leave items that create litter or obstruct the site.

cards.title: Watch the Flag Unfurling
cards.subtitle: Maryland state-flag display during football and basketball games
cards.notes: At a game, watch the student sections as two giant pieces of the Maryland flag descend with the historical video and familiar theme music.
cards.short_summary: A coordinated game-day reveal turns two student sections into a Maryland flag display.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD describes a tradition in which two giant pieces of the Maryland state flag are dropped from student sections during football and basketball games.
cards.source_title: Traditions & History | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Occurs during select home football and basketball games; ticket and venue rules may apply.

cards.title: Take Graduation Photos at the M
cards.subtitle: The floral M at Campus and Regents drives
cards.notes: If graduating, bring your cap and gown to the floral M for photos. Give other groups room and use the traffic-circle area carefully.
cards.short_summary: Graduating Terps gather at the floral M for a recognizable cap-and-gown photo.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says graduating Terps flock to the M in caps and gowns for photos, and calls it one of the university’s iconic landmarks.
cards.source_title: Traditions & History | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Located in a traffic circle at Campus and Regents drives; use sidewalks and observe traffic safety.

cards.title: Join the Basketball Flash Mob
cards.subtitle: Annual choreographed student-section moment at a home basketball game
cards.notes: If you attend the designated home game, follow the student section’s lead for the choreographed hopping and swaying sequence and venue instructions.
cards.short_summary: One home basketball game each year features a choreographed student-section flash mob.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD reports that students break into a choreographed flash mob at one home basketball game every year.
cards.source_title: Traditions & History | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Held at one home basketball game annually; ticketing, seating, and arena rules apply.

cards.entity_name: Reading The Diamondback at Basketball Games
cards.title: Read The Diamondback During Introductions
cards.subtitle: Student-section response to visiting-team announcements
cards.notes: At a basketball game, watch the student section during visiting-team introductions. The long-running routine uses UMD’s student newspaper as the prop.
cards.short_summary: Students conspicuously read or mime-reading the campus newspaper during visitor introductions.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD documents that students have long read, or pretended to read, The Diamondback at basketball games when visiting teams are announced.
cards.source_title: Traditions & History | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Observe during a home basketball game and follow arena conduct rules.

cards.title: Spot a Presidential Turtle Pin
cards.subtitle: Terp-spirit lapel-pin practice associated with UMD presidents
cards.notes: Keep an eye out for the turtle lapel pins shared at university events. The design has continued through several presidential administrations.
cards.short_summary: A golden turtle pin became a portable marker of Maryland spirit through presidential gifting.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says President Darryll J. Pines continues the practice of sharing his turtle-pin version with people he meets.
cards.source_title: Traditions & History | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Availability depends on university events and presidential outreach; no public distribution schedule is stated.

cards.title: Work Through the M Book Bucket List
cards.subtitle: Twenty UMD activities tracked through the Alumni Association’s M Book
cards.notes: Pick up or download the current M Book, then log the listed campus activities as you complete them. The program recognizes milestones with commemorative items.
cards.short_summary: A modern M Book turns twenty campus activities into a documented student tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: The UMD Alumni Association says the M Book Bucket List has 20 activities and that completing all 20 earns a Traditions Keeper medallion.
cards.source_title: M Book: A guide to the UMD student experience | University of Maryland Alumni Association
cards.access_notes: Current M Books are distributed at summer orientation and can be picked up at the Alumni Center during its stated business hours.

cards.title: Walk Around the Point of Failure
cards.subtitle: Great Fire memorial circle between Shoemaker and LeFrak halls
cards.notes: Find the marked circle between Shoemaker and LeFrak halls and read its historical context. Campus legend says avoiding its center helps graduation arrive on time.
cards.short_summary: A Great Fire memorial doubles as the setting for a four-year-graduation superstition.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD records the legend that students who step on the Point of Failure’s center will not graduate in four years.
cards.source_title: Landmarks | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Outdoor pavement marker between Shoemaker and LeFrak halls; keep clear of pedestrians.

cards.title: Learn the Maryland Fight Song
cards.subtitle: UMD’s 1941 fight song
cards.notes: Use the university’s lyrics and audio page to learn the fight song, then listen for it as Terps rally around athletic events and campus spirit.
cards.short_summary: The official 1941 fight song gives the recurring “Go Terps” refrain a campus home.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies the Maryland Fight Song as a 1941 work by Ralph Davis ’42, copyrighted by the University of Maryland Student Government Association.
cards.source_title: Songs | University of Maryland
cards.access_notes: Lyrics and an audio player are available on the university page.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Maryland-College Park, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A walkable, under-21-safe first-weekend sequence built around UMD landmarks, campus spaces, recreation and arts.

cards.title: Start with a campus orientation walk
cards.subtitle: University of Maryland Visitor Center · College Park
cards.notes: Begin by using UMD’s visitor resources and interactive campus map to identify buildings, landmarks and the routes you want to revisit over the weekend.
cards.short_summary: A practical first stop for getting oriented on the 1,350-acre campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s Visit page directs visitors to student-led tours, a self-guided tour and an interactive tool that identifies every campus building and parking option.
cards.source_title: Visit UMD
cards.access_notes: Check the Visit UMD page for current tour options and visitor information before going.

cards.title: Photograph the floral M
cards.subtitle: The M · Campus Drive
cards.notes: Pause at the large floral M on Campus Drive for an easy location marker, then continue toward the center of campus on foot.
cards.short_summary: A named UMD landmark planted with more than 850 flowers twice each year.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies the giant floral M on Campus Drive as a landmark and says more than 850 flowers are planted there twice annually.
cards.source_title: Visit UMD
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark; consult the campus map for walking directions.

cards.title: Cross McKeldin Mall
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Mall · central campus
cards.notes: Walk the length of the mall from Main Administration toward McKeldin Library and use the open lawn as the spine for your first campus loop.
cards.short_summary: A 16.28-acre academic mall linking Main Administration Building and McKeldin Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD describes McKeldin Mall as a 16.28-acre area extending from Main Administration Building to McKeldin Library.
cards.source_title: Visit UMD
cards.access_notes: Outdoor space; check the campus map and any event notices before planning a gathering there.

cards.title: Meet Testudo at the library
cards.subtitle: Testudo · in front of McKeldin Library
cards.notes: Find the original bronze Testudo outside McKeldin Library and take a close look at the polished nose before continuing your campus walk.
cards.short_summary: The original 1933 bronze mascot statue stands at the heart of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that the bronze Testudo in front of McKeldin Library is its best-known good-luck tradition and that rubbing its nose is customary.
cards.source_title: Landmarks
cards.access_notes: Outdoor landmark in front of McKeldin Library; be considerate of other visitors using the area.

cards.entity_name: Frederick Douglass Square at Hornbake Plaza
cards.title: Visit Frederick Douglass Square
cards.subtitle: Frederick Douglass Square · Hornbake Plaza
cards.notes: Make a short detour to Hornbake Plaza to view the memorial and use it as a waypoint while learning the north-side campus paths.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor memorial centered on an eight-foot bronze statue of Frederick Douglass.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s visitor guide identifies Frederick Douglass Square at Hornbake Plaza as a memorial with an eight-foot bronze statue honoring Douglass.
cards.source_title: Visit UMD
cards.access_notes: Outdoor memorial at Hornbake Plaza; verify the route on UMD’s interactive map.

cards.title: Get acquainted with Stamp
cards.subtitle: Adele H. Stamp Student Union · 3972 Campus Drive
cards.notes: Walk through Stamp to locate study areas, information services, galleries and the campus programs that may help shape your first few weeks.
cards.short_summary: UMD’s student union combines lounges, study space, information services, arts and entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog says Stamp offers lounge and study areas, information services, recreation, arts and entertainment, food and retail outlets, and event space.
cards.source_title: Adele H. Stamp Student Union - Center for Campus Life
cards.access_notes: The catalog lists academic-year building hours, with modified hours during summer and university breaks.

cards.title: Try a game at TerpZone
cards.subtitle: TerpZone · basement of Stamp Student Union
cards.notes: If you want a low-key group activity, check TerpZone’s availability and choose bowling, billiards or video games that fit your group and budget.
cards.short_summary: A Stamp recreation space with bowling lanes, billiards, video games and big-screen TVs.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD’s catalog identifies TerpZone in Stamp as having bowling lanes, cosmic bowling, billiard tables, video games and three big-screen TVs.
cards.source_title: Adele H. Stamp Student Union - Center for Campus Life
cards.access_notes: Located in Stamp; check TerpZone directly for current availability and any activity charges.

cards.title: Take a quiet chapel-and-garden pause
cards.subtitle: Memorial Chapel · 7744 Regents Drive
cards.notes: Add a daytime stop at the chapel and adjacent gardens for a quieter change of pace, then continue toward the recreation and arts destinations.
cards.short_summary: A multifaith campus chapel and garden open to people of all faiths, cultures and ways of being.
cards.evidence_claim: Memorial Chapel says its doors are open year-round to the campus community, alumni and wider community, and welcomes all faiths, cultures and ways of being.
cards.source_title: Memorial Chapel
cards.access_notes: Posted public hours are Monday through Friday, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.; weekends are closed except for events and worship services.

cards.title: Move at Eppley Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Eppley Recreation Center · North Campus
cards.notes: For an active afternoon, check access eligibility and choose from the listed cardio, court, climbing or aquatics activities rather than committing to a full routine.
cards.short_summary: A multipurpose recreation facility with cardio, courts, bouldering, swimming and group fitness options.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists cardio and weight training, basketball, a bouldering zone, racquetball and squash, swimming, badminton and group fitness among Eppley’s activities.
cards.source_title: Eppley Recreation Center
cards.access_notes: UMD states that a RecWell membership or facility rental is required; review current facility hours before visiting.

cards.title: End with an arts stop at The Clarice
cards.subtitle: Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center · campus arts district
cards.notes: Check the current calendar before you go, then use The Clarice as a final stop to identify performances, library resources and art spaces for later visits.
cards.short_summary: UMD’s performing-arts hub houses Clarice Presents, music, theatre, dance and the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies The Clarice as its performing-arts hub and home to Clarice Presents, the School of Music, theatre and dance programs, and the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library.
cards.source_title: Spaces | Arts for All
cards.access_notes: Check The Clarice’s event calendar and venue guidance for current performance access or ticket requirements.
